lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Welcome to the very first episode of Best Guess Live! All right, now you’ve probably heard some incredible news about Netflix over the past week or so, and I’m here to tell you it’s all true. You really can win big money playing Best Guess Live every weekday; you just have to be faster than the rest of the country.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Tonight, you are all part of Best Guess Live history. There will never be another first episode of Best Guess Live until the inevitable reboot in 2047.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Here’s how the game works. Each episode of Best Guess Live has two rounds, each round has one puzzle. Before each round, we’re going to load our crystal ball with a secret item; now it could be anything. Then I’ll give you five clues to figure it out.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: After each clue, you’ll get 20 seconds to submit an answer, but you only get one best guess per round—not one per clue, one per round. So make sure you’re confident before you lock it in. We do not accept typos.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Everyone that locks in a correct answer on the earliest clue will share in the money, and if you’re the only one to get it right on the earliest clue, you’ll win that entire prize pot for that round. And honestly, right now 8,000 players—these might be the best odds you’ve ever had to win.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: In fact, in my opinion, I think you should probably tell a friend right now to download the app and start playing so you have twice as good odds. But that’s just me, do what you want.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Now is your chance to do it though. Bottom line: you want to be fast, but you have to be right. Now, since this is such a historic moment, we want to see you guys playing. So, if it’s possible at some point, have someone in the room film you playing Best Guess Live and send us the video.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Tag us on your socials with #BestLive, and we’ll happily watch all of them. Enough talk, though; let’s start giving away some money!

lines.text: Oh, welcome to Best Guess Live! I’m so excited to be back. I’m your host, Hunter March, and I’m here for the first Monday of the year. Now, historically speaking, Mondays get a bad rap. lines.text: Here’s how it works: Each episode of Best Guess Live has two rounds. Each round has one puzzle. Before each round, we’re going to load our crystal ball with a secret item. lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Welcome to Best Guess Live! That’s right, I’m your host, Hunter March. Happy Friday! We’ve all put in a long, arduous week and we’re on the verge of the weekend. But before we go into full relax mode and shut our brains off for a couple of days, you guys should keep yours on just long enough to play our game.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Because tonight, like every night, we’ve got $15,000 up for grabs. Someone won $10,000 last night—I don’t know if you guys were here, that was crazy.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Here’s how the show works: Each episode of Best Guess Live has two rounds. Each round has one puzzle. Before each round we’re going to load our crystal ball with the secret item. Now, it could be anything. Then I’ll give you five clues. After each clue you’ll get 20 seconds to submit an answer, but you only get one best guess per round—not one per clue, one per round.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: So, make sure you’re confident before you lock it in. It has to be the exact right answer. We don’t accept typos. Also, all my friends make—they can rehearse this whole thing to me and they do, they just repeat it back to me. So I realize I’m repetitive, but it’s so you guys understand.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Everyone that locks in a correct answer on the earliest clue will share in the money, and if you’re the only one to get it right on the earliest clue, you’ll win that entire prize pot for that round.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Bottom line: you want to be fast, but you have to be right. And remember, if possible—I’m a broken record—make a video of you and/or your friends playing Best Guess Live. A mom, a dad, a son, a daughter, best friend, whatever. Send it to us with the hashtag #BestGuessLive. You can send it to me at @HunterMarch and I will happily share it with the world.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: By the way, if you’re not familiar with Inkind, it’s an app I’ve used. I’ve actually used it, I love it. Gives you discounts at your favorite restaurants. Anyway, we’ll get to that, but make sure you play our second puzzle. I’ll tell you more about the voucher later on. For now, let’s start this game and get down to business.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Here’s the fine print. Each episode of Best Guess Live has two rounds, each round has one puzzle. Before each round we’re going to load our crystal ball with a secret item; it could be anything. Then I’ll give you five clues. But remember, the clues are written like riddles—they’re meant to make you think.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: After each clue you’ll get 20 seconds to submit an answer, but you only get one best guess per round—not one per clue, one per round.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: So make sure you’re confident before you lock it in. It has to be the exact answer, and we don’t accept typos. Everyone that locks in a correct answer on the earliest clue will share in the money. And if you’re the only one to get it right on the earliest clue, you will win the entire prize pot for that round. Bottom line: you want to be fast, but you have to be right.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: And remember, if possible, make a video of you and your friends playing Best Guess Live. I got so many videos yesterday; you guys were so excited and then a little less excited once we found out how much, but I appreciate the videos nonetheless. #bestlive, @Hunter, @Netflixgames. We love it! With all that being said, let’s win some money!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Round one is worth $10,000. Let’s load the crystal ball with the first secret item. All right, Wild Wednesday crystal ball. Here we go. So here comes clue number one: 24. 20 seconds starts now.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: 24. Okay, for those of you that are new to the game, by the way, over 40,000 people already logged in. I love that some people come late every day. They’re like “Listen, I want the challenge, game’s too easy. Let me miss the first three clues.” 24 is the first clue. Good luck. Time’s up.

lines.text: “Big Den 948” said gold. 24 karat, it’s a good guess. “Breezy Jet 819” from Lynwood, California put Kobe; it’s definitely a California answer. “Jimmy Flapjacks” said crayons.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: I’LL BE BACK. “Chloe Quinn 18” said Target. “Arie Schwarzfelder”—I think that might be one of the worst misspellings we’ve ever had for what is not the correct answer anyway.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number three: THE DAY IS YOUNG. All right, 20 seconds on the clock starts now. 24, I’LL BE BACK, THE DAY IS YOUNG. I’ve heard about the night and its youth, but the day being young? 5 seconds left. Can the day rent a car? Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: THE DAY IS YOUNG. “Jaw Fixer” said sunrise. “Jean Street” said waffles—that is not a good guess. Maybe because it’s a breakfast food?

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number four: ALWAYS ARRIVES WITH A PLUS ONE. 20 seconds and the clock starts now. Does a sunrise have a plus one? I guess the sun, but that kind of is the rise. If the sunrise ever does come with a plus one, like a second sun, we’re all in so much trouble. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: ALWAYS ARRIVES WITH A PLUS ONE. “Ants in My Lance” said equation. Always arrives with a plus one, that’s a good guess.

Clue 1: 163 winners at $122.69 each.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Welcome to Best Guess Live! I am your host Howie Mandel. I get so excited every time I am standing right here getting ready to help you win a ton of money, but tonight I am next level excited because we have a very special guest announcer. Take it away!

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: She is only the second women’s triple crown champion in WWE history, she’s a two-time Smackdown Women’s Champion, a three-time Raw Women’s Champion, and the first woman ever to win both titles. She is an absolute legend of the ring, ladies and gentlemen, Alexa Bliss!

lines.speaker: Alexa Bliss
lines.text: Hello Best Guess Livers! Oh, it is so great to see you! Thank you for being here. I wouldn’t miss it; I love this show.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Well, I love doing it! It’s even better with you here. Alexa, turn out the lights… no, I can’t, I’m not talking to you. I would imagine there’s half the players playing in the dark at home right now. Okay, you’ve been champion, you’ve won Money in the Bank, how does being on Best Guess Live stack up to any of those moments?

lines.speaker: Alexa Bliss
lines.text: Well, I’m in the ring, my goal is to pump up the crowd, but here I actually get to help the crowd win money. Pretty cool, right?

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Very cool! In fact, I’m about to make it even cooler. If anyone guesses either puzzle on the first clue, I’m going to hit Howie here with a “Twisted Bliss.”

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Oh, the lawyers are saying we can’t do that. And I’m saying please, please don’t! I’m going to make the clues harder. Well, can I do an “Insult to Injury”? No? “Code Red”? Mrs. Mandel says no. I’m just going to go ahead and read the rules.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Round one is worth $5,000. Let’s load that crystal ball. Here is the first clue: RIGHT BACK AT YOU. 20 seconds on the clock starts now.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: RIGHT BACK AT YOU. “Miles Away 903” said a yo-yo. That’s clever. “Sh 17” said a mirror. “Jump Dogwood 154” said tennis. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number two: RETINA SWAP. Clock starts now. First clue was Right Back At You. “Moldy Sunshine 033” said contacts. “Moab 508” said wink. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Here’s your third clue: DELICIOUS OVER ICE. Clock starts now. You thinking? Trying to think. “Kevin on Earth 142” said hockey, which is delicious over ice. Have you ever tasted hockey? Just my puck. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Here’s the fourth clue: YOU’LL REGRET BECAUSE I NEVER FORGET. Clock starts now. “Jumpy Recliner” thinks an elephant. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Final clue for $5,000: WHAT MONTAZUMA NERDS AND THE SITH HAVE IN COMMON. Clock starts now. Clue one: Right Back At You. Clue two: Retina Swap. Clue three: Delicious Over Ice. Clue four: You’ll Regret Because I Never Forget. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: The answer is REVENGE.
Clue 5: "WHAT MONTAZUMA NERDS AND THE SITH HAVE IN COMMON." Revenge of the Nerds Revenge of the Sith and Montazuma's revenge. 3,179 got it right.
Clue 4: "YOU'LL REGRET BECAUSE I NEVER FORGET." If someone is set on revenge they hold that grudge. 483 got it right.
Clue 3: "DELICIOUS OVER ICE." Revenge is a dish best served cold. 53 got it right.
Clue 2: "RETINA SWAP." An eye for an eye classic phrase meaning revenge. 5 got it right.
Clue 1: "RIGHT BACK AT YOU." Revenge is literally when you get back at somebody right back at you. 8 got it right.
Clue 1: 8 winners at $625.00 each.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Round two is worth $10,000. Let’s load the crystal ball.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number one: OBVIOUSLY OUT OF SHAPE. Clock starts now. “Milky Dave 854” said a hippopotamus. For a hippo, that’s their look! Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Second clue: DOESN’T PRODUCE PRODUCE. Clock starts now. “Jolly Genius 734” said a supermarket. They sell it, they don’t produce it. “Rusty Level 212” said a zombie. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Third clue: ACRONYMS FEEL RIGHT AT HOME. Clock starts now. “Express Walrest 623” said SOS. “John 84” said IKEA. I always feel out of shape building IKEA furniture. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Fourth clue: AN INCREDIBLE TURN OF EVENTS. Clock starts now. “Twinkle Nose 844” said Elimination Chamber. Still traumatized by that? I was the first one eliminated! Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Final clue for $10,000: FAMOUS ARENA IN NYC MARCH 30TH HOST RAW FROM WWE. Clock starts now. A clue and a plug all in one! Time is up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: The answer is MADISON SQUARE GARDEN.
Clue 5: "FAMOUS ARENA IN NYC, MARCH 30TH HOST RAW FROM WWE." Madison Square Garden is New York City's most famous arena and has hosted major WWE events including Raw. 7,728 got it right.
Clue 4: "AN INCREDIBLE TURN OF EVENTS." Major events — playoffs, championships, concerts — are always happening inside its circular walls. 9 got it right.
Clue 3: "ACRONYMS FEEL RIGHT AT HOME." MSG is the beloved abbreviation, and acronyms are perfectly suited to a venue with such a long, iconic name. 11 got it right.
Clue 2: "DOESN'T PRODUCE PRODUCE." A "garden" implies growing produce, but Madison Square Garden grows nothing — it hosts concerts and sports. 7 got it right.
Clue 1: "OBVIOUSLY OUT OF SHAPE." Despite the name, MSG is famously round, not square — it has no square shape at all. 2 got it right.
Clue 1: 2 winners at $5,000.00 each.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: That’s it for Best Guess Live! Alexa, anything you want to say?

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Welcome to Best Guess Live! How’s it going? I’m your host Hunter March with glasses. This is the game where right answers could mean dramatic money and wrong answers could mean, well, comedy gold. Really, honestly, it’s worth it. Speaking of which, I want to take a second to talk to all of the people out there—and there are a lot of you—who send in ridiculous answers just trying to crack me up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: You are sacrificing your chance at big money every night just to get in a cheap joke, and I love you for it! Your kids might not like it when they can’t go to college, but I love it anyway.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: For all of you out there actually trying to win the money, I have a brand spanking new $15,000 up for grabs tonight. That’s right, it’s not a Wild Wednesday, but it’s still a good Wednesday. $15,000 in my opinion is still pretty wild. Here’s how you claim your money if you win.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Each episode of Best Guess Live has two rounds, each round has one puzzle. Before each round we’re going to load our crystal ball with a secret item; now it could be anything.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Then I’ll give you five clues. But remember, the clues are written like riddles—they’re meant to make you think, meant to get your juices going! After each clue you get 20 seconds to submit an answer, but you only get one best guess per round—not one per clue, one per round.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: So make sure you’re confident before you lock it in. It has to be the exact answer and we don’t accept typos. Everyone that locks in a correct answer on the earliest clue will share in the money. And if you’re the only one to get it right on the earliest clue, you’ll win that entire prize pot for that round.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Bottom line: you want to be fast, but you have to be right. Let’s win some money!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Round one is worth $5,000. Let’s load the crystal ball with the first secret item. What could it be? Mystical, magical. Here comes clue number one: THE DEPARTED. 20 seconds on the clock starts now.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: THE DEPARTED. Interesting. What could it be? I want to say so many things, but I feel like everything is going to be misleading or potentially leading… potentially misleadingly leading. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number one: THE DEPARTED. “We Woop 818” said Pluto—cuz it was a planet that departed. “Vinnie T” said airport. “Not That Gary” said Blockbuster Video—it’s a movie, they’ve departed.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number two: NOT A NOVEL NOVEL. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. THE DEPARTED, NOT A NOVEL NOVEL. Interesting, very interesting. You get three more clues if you’re new here, and then we go again for $10,000 on the next puzzle. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: “Baroque Goof” said remake. “Horned Polygon” said egg—maybe because of Game of Thrones? I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number three: MANY FRIENDS AREN’T FRIENDS. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. MANY FRIENDS AREN’T FRIENDS. That is your third clue. The earlier you answer, the better shot you have at winning some money. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: “Frothy Bagel” said high school. So true, me and Frothy Bagel were equally losers. “My Tai Bruce” said Leonardo DiCaprio.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number four: COVERED IN POSTERS THAT ARE EASY TO LIKE. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. THE DEPARTED, NOT A NOVEL NOVEL, MANY FRIENDS AREN’T FRIENDS, COVERED IN POSTERS THAT ARE EASY TO LIKE. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: “Sloppy Rocket 308” says Superman. “Skilled Bear” said I don’t know. Not a skilled bear! “Real Right” said magazine.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Final clue for this puzzle: THIS CLUE WAS META BEFORE META. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. For those wondering, “meta” does in fact legally rhyme with “meta,” so we’re safe. Time is up. Let’s find out what was inside the crystal ball.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: The correct answer was FACEBOOK.
Clue 5: "THIS CLUE WAS META BEFORE META." The company that is now Meta started with Facebook. 6,447 got it right.
Clue 4: "COVERED IN POSTERS THAT ARE EASY TO LIKE." The like button is a famous function of Facebook almost as popular as the poke. 2,257 got it right.
Clue 3: "MANY FRIENDS AREN'T FRIENDS." Just because you're a Facebook friend doesn't mean you're a real life friend. 726 got it right.
Clue 2: "NOT A NOVEL NOVEL." Well it's not actually a book and it's no longer new. 2 got it right.
Clue 1: "THE DEPARTED." Facebook was famously originally called the Facebook so the the departed. 2 got it right.
Clue 1: 2 winners at $2,500.00 each.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Round two, the prize doubles to $10,000. Let us load the crystal ball. $10,000 in there! I wish you the best of luck.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: First clue is: EXTREMELY DEPRESSING. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. EXTREMELY DEPRESSING. I see some fun answers already, which is ironic for such a sad first clue. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: EXTREMELY DEPRESSING. “Hot Crouton” put onion—because it makes you cry. “Rudy Terrier” put Starbucks—maybe because you have to tamp down espresso? “Nifty Slacks” said losing best guess. That is depressing!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number two: CHANGE IN PLANS. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. EXTREMELY DEPRESSING, CHANGE IN PLANS. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: “Pe-y” put breakup. “Mike Money Mo” put rain. “Franny Pack” put CPR. “Jenny Arcade” put diapers. At any age, that is a change in plans!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number three: STARTS AT THE BOTTOM AND STAYS THERE. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. Does an onion start at the bottom? Kind of, it’s a root vegetable. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: “Lefty Alien” said penny. “Whiskey the Cat” said feet. “Canadian Thermostat” said the bottom—because it’s cold.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number four: A HOLE IN ONE YOU DON’T CELEBRATE. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. A HOLE IN ONE YOU DON’T CELEBRATE. If there’s a hole in your onion, that’s usually a bad sign. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: “Jamming Man” said worm. “Thrice Psalm 26” said grave. It’s between onion and grave!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Fifth and final clue: A RUBBER FAIL WHEN YOUR CAR HITS A NAIL. 20 seconds starts now. EXTREMELY DEPRESSING, CHANGE IN PLANS, STARTS AT THE BOTTOM AND STAYS THERE, A HOLE IN ONE YOU DON’T CELEBRATE, A RUBBER FAIL WHEN YOUR CAR HITS A NAIL. Time is up. Let’s find out what was inside the crystal ball.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: The correct answer was a FLAT TIRE. The worst type of tire.
Clue 5: "A RUBBER FAIL WHEN YOUR CAR HITS A NAIL." Well that one speaks for itself. 7,554 got it right.
Clue 4: "A HOLE IN ONE YOU DON'T CELEBRATE." Well no one ever says yeah I caught a flat tire. 459 got it right.
Clue 3: "STARTS AT BOTTOM AND STAYS THERE." No matter where you go on a flat tire the flat part always stays at the bottom. 137 got it right.
Clue 2: "CHANGE IN PLANS." You're on the way to do one thing and now you have to change a tire instead. 265 got it right.
Clue 1: "EXTREMELY DEPRESSING." Obviously it's not only a total bummer but your tire is literally depressed. 93 got it right.
Clue 1: 93 winners at $107.52 each.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Congratulations to Monates Babs 27, Upper Satchel 961, Rab Kitten Glimmer, and 90 more! That’s it for this edition of Best Guess Live! We’re here every weekday at 8 Eastern, 5 Pacific. Come back tomorrow and don’t forget to bring your best guest! Good night!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Final clue for $5,000: BRIEF SNOOZE DURING THE DAY FEELING FRESH NOW YAY. 20 seconds starts now. If you think about it before you lock in, I’m right there with you. Time’s up. Let’s find out what was in the crystal ball!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: The answer was NAP.
Clue 5: "BRIEF SNOOZE DURING THE DAY, FEELING FRESH NOW...YAY!" You guys get it that's a nap. 9,569 got it right.

Clue 3: "DISCO POWER CAT." A disco nap a power nap and a catnap. 143 got it right.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Round two, the prize doubles to $10,000. Load the crystal ball. Clue number one: WAIT FOR IT… 20 seconds starts now.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: WAIT FOR IT… If you know it, don’t wait! “Purple Cobra 831” said flower. “Verse Peak 781” said DJ—waiting for the beat drop. “Charlie’s House” said jury duty. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Second clue: YOU’RE GETTING WARMER… (with ellipses). 20 seconds starts now. I missed an ellipses in a recent episode and got a talking to, so I’m hitting them hard! “Tater” said summer. “Mount Blazeit” said Hades. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Third clue: RUN… 20 seconds starts now. Clue one: Wait for it. Clue two: You’re getting warmer. Clue three: Run. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: RUN… “Mama Bear 057” from London, Ohio, said tag. “Chili Con Barney” said pantyhose—you get a run in your pantyhose! Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue four: CHILLING SPILLING OR A LAYER FOR A VILLAIN. 20 seconds starts now. Chilling, spilling, or a layer for a villain. 5 seconds left. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: “Bork Lover” said bath. “Broken Bandana 225” said jail.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Final clue: IF THE LAVAS ARE FLOWING YOU BEST BE A GOING. 20 seconds starts now. Final chance for $10,000! There’s only a couple things this could be. Time is up. Let’s find out what was inside the crystal ball!

Clue 1: 9 winners at $1,111.11 each.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: That is it for Best Guess Live! Congratulations to all of our winners. We’re here every weekday at 8 Eastern, 5 Pacific. See you tomorrow! Good night!

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Out! Me out out behind! Beep! Everybody looking! Welcome to Best Guess Live! I’m Howie Mandel, I’m going to be your host. It’s so much fun to put this show together every day. When you really stop and think about it… I just stopped and thought about it.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: The real winners on Best Guess Live are us—the staff and crew! It’s us, people, because we get to experience the joy of helping you win. Although I guess that would make you the winners… but since we get to help you win, we’re the winners? Okay, I’m confused.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: I guess it’s one of those classic win-win situations. But when there’s more than one winner, it’s like a win-win-win situation! And when there’s a lot of winners, it’s like a win-win-win-win-win! You get it. Here are the rules. Each episode of Best Guess Live has two rounds, each round has one puzzle.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Before each round we’re going to load our crystal ball with a secret item; it could be absolutely anything.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Then I’ll give you five clues. But remember, the clues are written like riddles—they make you think! After each clue you’ll get 20 seconds to submit an answer. But you only get one best guess per round. Not one per clue, one per round. So make sure you’re confident before you lock it in.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: It has to be the exact answer and we don’t accept typos. Everyone that locks in a correct answer on the earliest clue will share in the money. Bottom line: you want to be fast, but you have to be right. Let’s win some money!

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Round one is worth $5,000. Let’s load the crystal ball. We got a lot of first-time players: Tiny Might 03 and Royal Poncho 353, welcome! Here comes clue number one: MASS TRANSIT. 20 seconds on the clock starts now.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: MASS TRANSIT. $5,000 at stake! A lot of people taking a shot right off the bat. “Fake Domain 175” said subway. “I Need Tuition Money” (is that a name or a request?) said Crocs. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number two: HELP WANTED SIGN. Clock starts now. Almost 11,000 submitted answers already. “Skinny Horseshoe 298” said crying—because you want help if you’re crying? A lot of people cry on the subway, I get it. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number three: WRONG WAY, SUCKER. Clock starts now. I like saying “sucker.” “Jimmy Domino 234” said popsicle stick. “Little Miss Riot” said jail. Mass transit to jail? You live in a rough neighborhood! Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number four: I’LL TAKE A BLT, MAKE IT SPEEDY, AND HOLD THE WITCH. Clock starts now. These are good riddles! “Burly Ice Cream 484” said a big luxurious tiger. Okay! Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Final clue for $5,000: DON’T MAKE A STINK. THAT SAND MAKES YOU SINK. Clock starts now. Clue one: Mass Transit. Clue two: Help Wanted Sign. Clue three: Wrong Way, Sucker. Clue four: BLT hold the witch. Time is up! Let’s find out what’s in that crystal ball.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: It’s QUICKSAND! Wait a minute, was that me going down in the video? You guys are nuts!
Clue 5: "DON'T MAKE A STINK. THAT SAND MAKES YOU SINK." When you're in the quicksand you don't make a stink... sand makes you sink. 5,358 got it right.
Clue 4: "I'LL TAKE A BLT, MAKE IT SPEEDY, AND HOLD THE WITCH." BLT is a sandwich hold the witch is sand make it speedy is quick. 403 got it right.
Clue 3: "WRONG WAY, SUCKER." Quicksand sucks you down which is not the direction you want to go.
Clue 2: "HELP WANTED SIGN." When you start sinking it's a sign you want help.
Clue 1: "MASS TRANSIT." Your body is a mass and quicksand moves it.
Clue 4: 403 winners at $12.40 each.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: The prize doubles to $10,000! Let’s load that crystal ball. Clue number one: POPULAR FIRST DATE. Clock starts now.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: POPULAR FIRST DATE. “Charlie’s Horse 38” said January—that is a popular first date, in the top 12! “Ripe Cheetah 452” said movies. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number two: OPPOSITES ATTRACT. Clock starts now. Almost 13,000 people guessed on that first clue. “Mark It Dude 95” said crossing your eyes. I’m going to guess you’re single. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number three: FANCY MEETING YOU HERE. Clock starts now. “Car 585” said Tinder Platinum. “I’ve Got 2325” said In-N-Out. That is a good burger. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Clue number four: WHEN THE REEF SAYS, “WHERE’S THE BEEF?” Clock starts now. “Dorothy Marker 21” said a cowfish. “Olly Pauly 10” said Arby’s. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: Final clue for $10,000: RHYMING DISH OF SEA AND MEAT THAT MANY PEOPLE LOVE TO EAT. Clock starts now. Last chance! Time’s up. 30,000 submissions! Let’s see the crystal ball.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: It is SURF AND TURF! I love lobster.
Clue 5: "RHYMING DISH OF SEA AND MEAT THAT MANY PEOPLE LOVE TO EAT." They rhyme and they're sea and meat it makes sense. 5,424 got it right.
Clue 4: "WHEN THE REEF SAYS, "WHERE'S THE BEEF?"" The reef is in the surf the beef is the turf. 941 got it right.
Clue 3: "FANCY MEETING YOU HERE." They are both fancy proteins... when does a lobster meet a steak? 8 got it right.
Clue 2: "OPPOSITES ATTRACT." One is from the land one is from the sea and they attract each other. 6 got it right.
Clue 1: "POPULAR FIRST DATE." Seafood and cows grew up in different neighborhoods... plus it is a popular dish.
Clue 2: 6 winners at $1,666.66 each.

lines.speaker: Howie Mandel
lines.text: That is it for Best Guess Live! Congratulations to the winners. Now head over to Netflix for their exclusive coverage of tonight’s MLB season opener between the Yankees and the Giants happening right now! It’s the first time the MLB season has kicked off on a global streaming service. Go check it out! See you tomorrow! Good night!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Out! Out! Out! Behind! Come on, we’re going! Welcome to Best Guess Live! Hello, hello, how we doing? I’m your host Hunter March. It’s only Thursday and we have already added 55 people to the winner circle this week. That means we are averaging over 168 winners per day—that’s a lot!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: You know how many winners other game shows have every day? Jeopardy? One max. Wheel of Fortune? One. Family Feud? Five, but it’s only one family. Let’s be honest, it’s only going to one person. Technically, we’re 168 times financially better than those shows. That’s not my opinion; that’s just math, people!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: If you want to get on the winner’s train and help us continue our undeniable dominance, here is how the show works. Each episode of Best Guess Live has two rounds, each round has one puzzle. Before each round we’re going to load our crystal ball with a secret item; it could be anything.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Then I’ll give you five clues. Remember though, those clues are written like riddles—they’re meant to make you think!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: After each clue you’ll get 20 seconds to submit an answer, but you only get one best guess per round—not one per clue, one per round. So make sure you’re confident before you lock it in. It has to be the exact answer and we don’t accept typos. Everyone that locks in a correct answer on the earliest clue will share in the money.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: And if you’re the only one to get it right on the earliest clue, you win that entire prize pot! Bottom line: you want to be fast, but you have to be right. Let’s win some money!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Round one is worth $5,000. Let’s load the crystal ball with the first secret item. Possibilities are endless! Here comes clue number one: MUST OR BUST. 20 seconds on the clock starts now.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: MUST OR BUST. “Loyal Geranium 492” from Florida said high five—maybe you get left hanging, it’s a bust. “Scooby Pup 101” said darts—you got to get it right on the right number. “Turtle Pie” said gas station bathroom—I don’t like that their name is Turtle Pie either. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number two: PLUNGING NECKLINE. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. I’ll let you think. It’s not my game to lose for you; it’s your game to win for you. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: PLUNGING NECKLINE. “Miss Ginger Moon” from Orlando said elevator—ideally not plunging too fast. “Twisted Sunset 503” from Detroit said V-neck. “Terrific Fish” said giraffe—they’ve got a very long neck.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number three: FOR OPEN-MINDED PEOPLE. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. I don’t look great in a V-neck, so for me, V-neck’s out. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: FOR OPEN-MINDED PEOPLE. “Southern Bell 619” said zipper—I guess if your brain surgeon left a zipper, cool. “JNL20” said burped people.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number four: YOU KNOW THE DRILL. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. One more after this. 13 seconds left. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: YOU KNOW THE DRILL. “Zelda Husky” from Jacksonville said mullet. Yeah, you know the drill, time to let people know we fight!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number five, your fifth and final clue: DON’T WHINE IT’S FOR OPENING THE WINE. 20 seconds starts now. Thank you for playing on this Thursday! Over 30,000 people are in here right now trying to win this $5,000. Time is up. Let’s find out what’s inside the crystal ball!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: The correct answer is a CORKSCREW. I one time on a date tried to open a wine bottle for the first time and destroyed the cork—it ruined everything.
Clue 5: "DON'T WHINE, IT'S FOR OPENING THE WINE." That is how you open a bottle of wine. 7,079 got it right.
Clue 4: "YOU KNOW THE DRILL." Corkscrews look like drills they're just little drills. 7 got it right.
Clue 3: "FOR OPEN-MINDED PEOPLE." It's very useful when opening wine is on your mind. 4 got it right.
Clue 2: "PLUNGING NECKLINE." You plunge a corkscrew into the neck of a wine bottle. 1 got it right.
Clue 1: "MUST OR BUST." When you want to open wine you need a corkscrew or you got to bust the bottle open.
Clue 2: 1 winner at $5,000.00 each.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Round two, the prize doubles to $10,000! Load the crystal ball. Clue number one: STRANGELY FAMILIAR. 20 seconds starts now.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: STRANGELY FAMILIAR. A lot of things are strange, a lot are familiar. “Everything is Cake” from Columbia said fan. “Domestic Ranch 803” said salsa. “Clean Garbage” put Benedict Cumberbatch—he’s Doctor Strange! Our resident nerd figured that out immediately. Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number two: CONFUSING IN A LINEUP. 20 seconds starts now. Must you get your clue in now, or do you risk a potential bust? Time’s up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: CONFUSING IN A LINEUP. “Alpha Ash 4” from New Hampshire said twin. “Fiona Rules” said triplets. Everyone’s on the same path.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number three: APPEARS IN BOOZE BRANDS. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. If you don’t win tonight, there’s always tomorrow! Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: APPEARS IN BOOZE BRANDS. “Strict Cyborg 207” from New York said mascot. “Donald Truck 211” said alcohol—could you imagine if it was that easy for a clue three?

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Clue number four: BACK IN BLACK COVERED BY THE WHITE STRIPES. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. This show was created by a very musical group of people and they wanted me to sing the Back in Black part. I’m not great at that Australian accent. Time is up.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: BACK IN BLACK COVERED BY THE WHITE STRIPES. “Flat Chair 227” from North Carolina said NASCAR—a road with white stripes. “Affordable Dynamite” put banger.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: Final clue: THE OBVIOUS REFEREE OF THE ANIMAL KINGDOM. 20 seconds on the clock starts now. Final chance for $10,000! Time’s up. Let’s find out what was inside the crystal ball!

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: The correct answer was a ZEBRA!
Clue 5: "THE OBVIOUS REFEREE OF THE ANIMAL KINGDOM." Referees look exactly like zebras. 6,005 got it right.
Clue 4: "BACK IN BLACK COVERED BY THE WHITE STRIPES." Body is black and they're covered in white stripes. 1,336 got it right.
Clue 3: "APPEARS IN BOOZE BRANDS." The end of booze is ZE and the start of brands is BR put them together. 20 got it right.
Clue 2: "CONFUSING IN A LINEUP." It would be very confusing in a lineup they do look the same. 23 got it right.
Clue 1: "STRANGELY FAMILIAR." They have the familiar shape of a horse but they look insane. 1 got it right.
Clue 1: 1 winner at $10,000.00 each.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: That is it for this edition of Best Guess Live! Congratulations to both of our winners. We’re here every weekday at 8 Eastern, 5 Pacific. Come back tomorrow! Good night!

lines.text: Welcome to Best Guess Live! How’s it going, everybody? I’m your host, Hunter March. Now, one of the things we love about the new prize system is that there are more winners, but I want to talk about one person who took home some serious cash last night.

lines.speaker: Hunter March
lines.text: So unless you don’t like easy money, stick around for our second puzzle because on that puzzle, along with our regular medal prizes, you could still win a $5 voucher to the Netflix Shop if you haven’t already.
